name: TCGplayer API
tagline: Marketplace product catalog and market pricing for Magic, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh, and more
description: TCGplayer API provides access to product catalog data and market pricing for trading card games including Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and other TCGs. Developers can query products, categories, pricing, and marketplace information for building collection tools, price trackers, and inventory apps.
use_cases: get current market price for a Magic card
search Pokémon product catalog by name
